guard.notes: A PreToolUse matcher in .claude/settings.json calls bun .guardrails/src/cli.ts evaluate with AGENT_RUNTIME=claude and AGENT_RUNTIME_CONFIG=.agents/runtime/claude/config.json. Exit 0 allows and exit 2 blocks. MCP servers are registered in .mcp.json and enabled in .claude/settings.json.

capabilitiesNotes: subagentSpawn: this repository's own Harness Console event log (.agents/.tmp/events/*.jsonl) records hundreds of successful `Agent` tool.pre/tool.post pairs across sessions here, and every role charter and .agents/runtime/*/config.json already names a `subagents` model tier the master dispatches to - a working, exercised feature, not a belief about the vendor. resume: the same event log records repeated successful `SendMessage` calls (18 as of 2026-09-20), which the Agent tool's own description defines as resuming a previously spawned background agent with full context; grounded in this session's own tool contract plus recorded successful use, not general recall. cancel: the event log records repeated successful `TaskStop` calls (14 as of 2026-09-20), stopping a running background agent - a confirmed, exercised capability. toolEvents: `.claude/settings.json` wires a PreToolUse matcher to `tooling/agentos/agent-hooks/src/guard.ts` (this repository's own hook, ADR-0019), and the event log holds tens of thousands of recorded tool.pre/tool.post pairs from it - the harness itself calls out on every tool use, which is the definition of the capability. usage: `tooling/agentos/console/src/collectors/observe-costs.ts` and docs/platform/agentic-os-console.md say so directly - "Claude Code's hooks do not report usage, and reading transcripts is opt-in" / "Claude Code transcripts - not built; opt-in by design (14 §2) - would give exact token usage, which is why Costs has no actuals today". The standard hook path this repository actually uses carries no token or cost figures; marked unsupported on that confirmed absence rather than on the unbuilt, opt-in transcript path, which is a different and unverified question. worktreeAwareness: this session's own tool list carries native `EnterWorktree`/`ExitWorktree` tools, and the event log records five successful, `ok:true` pairs of them against a real path under .claude/worktrees/ in this repository - used, not merely offered.
pricingNotes: The model identifiers are confirmed; the rates are the placeholder tiers carried over from tooling/agentos/delivery/src/pricing.ts and are not tariffs. `delivery estimate` prints a warning while this flag is false. Replace them with the published rates and set the flag before any number here is quoted as a cost.

permissions.notes: Tool safety is enforced by native PreToolUse hooks; read and write follow the host's own permission model (plan and accept modes). Structural changes to roles, agents or skills always need explicit user approval, in every mode.
